testimonials.quote: I've been really impressed with how April's been able to keep the ship running while onboarding a person who's new to Kubernetes and Rancher. It's a lot for any one person.
testimonials.author: Max Kadel

testimonials.quote: April's been so helpful with deployment issues. She kept dialogue going while she fixed the issue and took the time to walk me through her process and solution after. I got to ask a bunch of questions and see how all the pieces fit together.
testimonials.author: Sarah Proctor

testimonials.quote: The client was genuinely impressed and grateful for April's thorough, well-organized documentation. She set clear expectations for the handoff that made a real difference.
testimonials.author: Jill O'Connor

testimonials.quote: Huge wins clearing out EFS storage, potentially saving many thousands of dollars annually. April's focus on AWS cost controls delivered wins across the board.
testimonials.author: Nicholas Steinwachs
